name: 01520 · Holden, MA
findings: ZIP 01520 (Holden) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01520 (Holden) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01520 (Holden) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
